cues.en: This is something that we started our course with the idea that when learning something with our limited
cues.zh: 我們在課程一開始，就提出過這個觀念：當時間

cues.en: time and resource, we need to make sure that we understand the most important concept.
cues.zh: 和資源有限，學習某樣東西時，就要確定自己理解最重要的概念。

cues.en: Why are we learning this?
cues.zh: 我們為什麼要學這個？

cues.en: Why is this worth my time?
cues.zh: 為什麼值得花我的時間？

cues.en: And why is this something that I should dedicate this time to?
cues.zh: 為什麼我應該把時間投入其中？

cues.en: Too often we see new things in the developer ecosystem.
cues.zh: 開發者生態系裡，常常出現新東西。

cues.en: It is always exciting to be working on the newest and shiniest thing that everybody is talking about.
cues.zh: 能使用最新、最熱門、大家都在談的東西，總是令人興奮。

cues.en: But remember those libraries and frameworks and configuration files and tools?
cues.zh: 但還記得那些函式庫、框架、設定檔和工具嗎？

cues.en: Those things come and go.
cues.zh: 它們來來去去。

cues.en: They're always changing.
cues.zh: 總是在變。

cues.en: You can be a master of Webpack one day and two years later nobody cares because there's a better tool out there.
cues.zh: 今天你可能是 Webpack 高手，兩年後卻沒人在乎，因為已經有更好的工具。

cues.en: The things that stick around are the fundamental computer science topics and software development practices.
cues.zh: 能長久留下來的，是電腦科學的基本主題與軟體開發實務。

cues.en: Sure, these things change over time as well, but they always evolve slowly.
cues.zh: 當然，它們也會隨時間改變，但演進總是比較慢。

cues.en: With y in mind when learning new things.
cues.zh: 學新東西時，心裡要想著「為什麼」。

cues.en: Make sure you understand why the solution was created.
cues.zh: 確定自己理解：為什麼會有人建立這個解法？

cues.en: What problem is it solving and why is this the answer to your problems?
cues.zh: 它解決了什麼問題？為什麼它能解決你的問題？

cues.en: If you're able to do this, you stop being a player in the game of catch up and the developer ecosystem
cues.zh: 如果做得到，就不再需要在開發者生態系裡玩追趕遊戲，

cues.en: always trying to learn the latest library, the newest tool, the coolest functions to learn.
cues.zh: 總是忙著學最新的函式庫、最新工具、最酷的新功能。

cues.en: It's like a game of hamster who's constantly trying to keep up with the wheel, trying to run on that
cues.zh: 那就像倉鼠一直追著滾輪跑，拼命在

cues.en: wheel, but instead be an observer who is watching the ecosystem evolve from above.
cues.zh: 輪子上奔跑。你應該成為從上方觀察生態系演變的觀察者。

cues.en: Watch how new libraries come and go.
cues.zh: 看著新的函式庫如何興起、消失。

cues.en: Understand the why of each libraries, what problems they solve.
cues.zh: 理解每個函式庫的存在理由，以及它們解決的問題。

cues.en: Understand the big picture, why we do things.
cues.zh: 了解全貌，了解我們為什麼這樣做。

cues.en: But be the observer, not the hamster.
cues.zh: 當觀察者，而不是倉鼠。

cues.en: You'll have a happier, longer career overall.
cues.zh: 整體而言，你的職涯會更快樂、更長久。

cues.en: Trust me, you won't be constantly trying to catch up with every library and framework this way.
cues.zh: 相信我，這樣就不用一直追趕每一個函式庫與框架。

cues.en: This big picture vision is what makes a senior developer or a manager or a leader.
cues.zh: 這種掌握全貌的視野，是資深開發人員、主管或領導者的重要特質。

cues.en: They don't have narrow vision.
cues.zh: 他們不會只看到狹窄的一角。

cues.en: They see the entire ecosystem and they are able to make smart decisions because of that.
cues.zh: 他們看得到整個生態系，因此能做出明智的決定。

cues.en: So always start with why.
cues.zh: 所以，永遠從「為什麼」開始。
